sentences.en: TopSage.com My name's Dan Pearman and I'd like to talk about the work of Pedal Power, a small charity based mainly in the UK.
sentences.zh: TopSage.com 我叫丹·皮尔曼，今天想为大家介绍一家名为“踏板动力”（Pedal Power）的小型慈善机构的工作，该机构总部主要设在英国。

sentences.en: I'll be giving our contact details at the end, if anyone would like to find out more about how to support us.
sentences.zh: 我将在最后提供我们的联系方式，如果您想进一步了解如何支持我们，请随时联系我们。

sentences.en: But first, how the charity began.
sentences.zh: 但首先，让我们了解一下这家慈善机构的创立缘起。

sentences.en: I got the idea of exporting bicycles to developing countries while I was in Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 我在厄瓜多尔时萌生了向发展中国家出口自行车的想法。

sentences.en: I went there in 1993 just after graduating from university.
sentences.zh: 我于1993年大学毕业后前往厄瓜多尔。

sentences.en: After three years of studying, I wanted adventure.
sentences.zh: 经过三年的学习，我渴望一场冒险。

sentences.en: I loved travelling, so I decided to join a voluntary organisation and was sent to Ecuador to carry out land surveys.
sentences.zh: 我热爱旅行，因此决定加入一家志愿组织，并被派往厄瓜多尔开展土地勘测工作。

sentences.en: The project came to an end after five years and when returned to the UK in 1998, I started planning Pedal Power.
sentences.zh: 该项目于五年后结束，1998年我返回英国后，便开始筹划创办“踏板动力”。

sentences.en: Where I lived in Ecuador was a very rural area.
sentences.zh: 我在厄瓜多尔居住的地方是一个非常偏远的农村地区。

sentences.en: My neighbour had the only bicycle in the village, whereas everyone else walked everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我邻居拥有村里唯一一辆自行车，而其他所有人全靠步行出行。

sentences.en: My neighbour's business was unusually successful, and for years I couldn't understand why.
sentences.zh: 我邻居的生意异常成功，多年来我一直不明白其中原因。

sentences.en: Then I realised having a bike meant he could get where he wanted to go without much trouble.
sentences.zh: 后来我才意识到，拥有一辆自行车意味着他可以轻松抵达想去的任何地方。

sentences.en: Other local carpenters could only accept jobs in a three-kilometre radius, so no matter how skilled they were, they could never do as many jobs as my neighbour.
sentences.zh: 当地其他木匠只能承接三公里半径范围内的工作，因此无论技艺多么高超，他们所能完成的工作量永远无法超过我的邻居。

sentences.en: At Pedal Power, we collect second-hand bikes in the UK and send them to some of the poorest regions in the world.
sentences.zh: 在‘踏板动力’，我们在英国收集二手自行车，并将它们运送到全球最贫困的一些地区。

sentences.en: When we distribute bikes overseas we don't give them away for free.
sentences.zh: 我们在海外分发自行车时，并非免费赠送。

sentences.en: We'd like to, but long term that doesn't really help the local economy.
sentences.zh: 我们很想这么做，但从长远来看，这实际上无助于当地经济发展。

sentences.en: The demand for bikes is enormous, which makes them very expensive locally.
sentences.zh: 当地对自行车的需求极为庞大，导致其本地价格极其昂贵。

sentences.en: So we sell them for 5% of the normal price.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们仅以正常价格的5%出售这些自行车。

sentences.en: But in order to continue operating we need to have a constant supply of bikes which we send out every six months.
sentences.zh: 但为了持续运营，我们需要稳定供应自行车，每六个月向海外发送一批。

sentences.en: One example of a town that's received bicycles from Pedal Power is Rivas.
sentences.zh: 一个曾接收过‘踏板动力’自行车的城镇是里瓦斯（Rivas）。

sentences.en: It was the first place I sent a full container of bicycles to.
sentences.zh: 那里是我首次整箱运送自行车的目的地。

sentences.en: Most people there now own a bicycle.
sentences.zh: 如今，当地大多数人都拥有一辆自行车。

sentences.en: The local economy has developed so much, you wouldn't recognise it as the same place.
sentences.zh: 当地经济已取得巨大发展，您甚至无法认出它还是原来那个地方。

sentences.en: In fact, there are more bikes than on the streets of Amsterdam, if you've ever been there.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那里的自行车数量比您若曾到访过的阿姆斯特丹街头还要多。

sentences.en: But Pedal Power still needs your help.
sentences.zh: 但‘踏板动力’仍需要您的帮助。

sentences.en: You may have read about some of our recent problems in the British media.
sentences.zh: 您可能已在英国媒体上读到我们近期遭遇的一些困难。

sentences.en: In August 2000, we simply ran out of money.
sentences.zh: 2000年8月，我们资金彻底耗尽。

sentences.en: We had containers of bikes ready to send, but no money to pay the bills.
sentences.zh: 当时我们已有装满自行车的集装箱待运，却无力支付相关账单。

sentences.en: It was a terrible situation. 015 We managed to ensure the bikes went out on time, but the other problems carried on for several months.
sentences.zh: 那是一段极其艰难的时期。015 我们设法确保了自行车如期发出，但其他问题又持续了数月之久。

sentences.en: Fortunately in October 2001 we won an Enterprise Award which helped us enormously.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，2001年10月我们荣获了一项企业奖，这对我们帮助极大。

sentences.en: We invested fifteen of the seventy-five-thousand-pound prize money to help secure our future.
sentences.zh: 我们将七万五千英镑奖金中的一万五千英镑投入机构建设，以保障我们未来的发展。

sentences.en: Winning the award helped raise our profile, and the money enabled us to pay all our shipping costs, which represent our greatest expense.
sentences.zh: 获奖极大提升了我们的公众知名度，而奖金也使我们得以支付全部运输费用——这笔开支正是我们最大的支出项目。

sentences.en: Pedal Power changes lives - when someone gets a bicycle from us, they see a 14% increase in their income.
sentences.zh: ‘踏板动力’改变人们的生活——当某人从我们这里获得一辆自行车后，其收入平均增长14%。

sentences.en: We're currently looking to invest in computers so that our office staff can do an even better job.
sentences.zh: 目前我们正计划投资购置电脑，以便办公室员工能更出色地完成工作。

sentences.en: Because of our work, people in a number of countries now have a better standard of living - so far www.TopSage.com Tapescripts } LA we've provided 46,000 people with bikes.
sentences.zh: 由于我们的工作，若干国家民众的生活水平已得到改善——截至目前，www.TopSage.com 笔记稿 } LA 我们已为46,000人提供了自行车。

sentences.en: But we'd like to send more, at least 50,000 by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 但我们希望送出更多，力争在今年年底前达到至少50,000辆。

sentences.en: TopSage.com Now there are many ways in which you can support the work of Pedal Power, not just by taking a bike to a collection in your arca. should also like to say if you do have a bike to donate, it doesn't matter what condition it's in - if we can't repair it, we'll strip it down for spare parts.
sentences.zh: TopSage.com 现在，支持‘踏板动力’的方式多种多样，不仅限于将自行车送至您所在地区的回收点。我还想特别说明：若您有意捐赠自行车，车况如何并无关系——即便我们无法修复，也会将其拆解用作零配件。

sentences.en: Of course, to do that we always need tools, which are expensive 018/19/20 to buy, so we welcome any that you can give.
sentences.zh: 当然，为实现这一目标，我们始终需要工具，而工具采购成本高昂，018/19/20 因此我们非常欢迎您捐赠任何可用工具。

sentences.en: Also, you could help by contacting the voluntary staff at our offices, they'll be able to suggest activities you could organise to 018/19/20 bring in funds for us.
sentences.zh: 此外，您也可通过联系我们在办公室的志愿者工作人员来提供帮助；他们将为您推荐可组织的各类筹款活动。

sentences.en: People do all kinds of things - including, of course, sponsored bike rides.
sentences.zh: 人们会举办各种各样的活动——当然也包括有赞助的自行车骑行活动。

sentences.en: Also, we're always interested to hear of other places that would benefit from 018/19/20 receiving a consignment of bikes, and welcome suggestions from people who've been to developing regions on their travels.
sentences.zh: 同时，我们始终乐于听取有关其他可能受益于接收一批自行车的地区建议，也欢迎曾赴发展中国家旅行的朋友们提出推荐。

sentences.en: We hope that by talking on radio programmes like this, we will be able to raise public awareness, which will lead to government organisations also giving us regular financial support, something that we really need.
sentences.zh: 我们希望通过参与此类广播节目，提高公众认知度，从而促使政府机构也能为我们提供稳定的财政支持——这正是我们真正急需的。

sentences.en: If you'd like some more information about where to donate an old bicycle or offer help in other ways please contact us on ..
sentences.zh: 如果您希望获取更多关于捐赠旧自行车或以其他方式提供帮助的信息，请联系我们……
